name: tension
description: Two legitimate sides pulling against each other inside a domain.

aiGuidance.purpose: Public word: trade-off. A tension contains exactly two poles (core contains), both legitimate; health is movement between them, failure is collapse onto one.
aiGuidance.extraction: Title names the pair ('Action: Act / Observe'); description says what is being traded.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Never rank one pole as the wrong one. Do not store the poles in a text field; they are pole records.
